importantInterpretationRules: An empty toxicityEvidence list means no curated evidence is stored; it does not mean the compound is non-toxic.
Keep experimental toxicity evidence separate from RDKit descriptors and heuristic screening outputs.
Do not infer a definitive toxic/non-toxic classification from molecular descriptors alone.
Record endpoint, assay, species or test system, exposure route, dose/concentration, units, and source whenever available.
